{{Quote|Eriadu endures.|[[Shea Hublin]]|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''Eriadu Authority''' was a splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was centered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

The Eriadu Authority was established after breaking from the Galactic Empire during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sander Delvardus]], a member of the prestigious [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]] by [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]], and an independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]].

Originally based on Eriadu, it was forced to relocate into exile on [[Kampe]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], after being [[Battle of Sullust (Delvardus campaign)|defeated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Delvardus was executed at a conference on [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]] along with twelve other Imperial warlords to unify by Admiral [[Natasi Daala]]. The Eriadu Authority then fell to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ivan Cronus]] who pledged it to Daala's [[United Warlord Fleets]], an alliance of warlords. However, after the disaster that was the [[Assault on Yavin 4]], Daala relinquished [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|full command]] to [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the [[Greater Maldrood]], who absorbed the Eriadu Authority and other Imperial factions into the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==Astrography==
The Authority held the allegiance of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], the capital, and all the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]. It included other worlds all around this sector like [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], [[Sanrafsix/Legends|Sanrafsix]], [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] and [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. The Eriadu Authority encompassed also many worlds all along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], including [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]].
